author: niroularikesh
title: Considering a Switch from eSewa to IME Pay Due to New Transaction Fees
review_text: I have been using eSewa for over a decade and have always been satisfied with their services. Recently, however, they have implemented a charge of 10 rupees for P2P transactions. This new fee has prompted me to explore alternative options for digital payments. As a result, I am now considering switching to IME Pay, which offers competitive features and could better suit my needs without incurring additional transaction costs.
